candidates.formal_type:
∀ (A : Type u) [inst : Ring.{u} A] (M : ModuleCat.{u, u} (MulOpposite.{u} A))
  {S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.{u, u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u, u} A)},
  CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.{u, u + 1} S →
    ∀ (n₀ n₁ : Nat),
      Eq.{1} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n₀ 1) n₁ →
        Exists.{u + 1} fun δ =>
          CategoryTheory.ComposableArrows.Exact.{u, u + 1}
            (CategoryTheory.ComposableArrows.mk₅.{u, u + 1}
              (Etingof.torSndMap.{u} A (ModuleCat.Hom.hom.{u, u} (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.f.{u, u + 1} S)) n₁ M)
              (Etingof.torSndMap.{u} A (ModuleCat.Hom.hom.{u, u} (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.g.{u, u + 1} S)) n₁ M) δ
              (Etingof.torSndMap.{u} A (ModuleCat.Hom.hom.{u, u} (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.f.{u, u + 1} S)) n₀ M)
              (Etingof.torSndMap.{u} A (ModuleCat.Hom.hom.{u, u} (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.g.{u, u + 1} S)) n₀ M))
